chapters.name: Two Sides
chapters.goal: Fight through the carriers and reach the end of the route.
chapters.hint: Left Shift folds the route. Right Shift unfolds it. Watch the grid and the accepted side, then meet the carriers.

chapters.name: Quiet Belt
chapters.goal: Reach the exit through a quiet asteroid belt.
chapters.hint: Break or avoid asteroids. Enemy shots can break them too. Watch for an occasional carrier.

chapters.name: Counter Cycle
chapters.goal: Reach the route end while fighting the three-operation carriers.
chapters.hint: Position Warp counters Vector Lens. Vector Lens counters Impact Buffer. Impact Buffer counters Position Warp.

chapters.name: Loose Stones
chapters.goal: Reach the exit among asteroids and scattered carriers.
chapters.hint: Use the three-operation set with less incoming fire. Rocks can block shots from either side.

chapters.name: Seven Operations
chapters.goal: Reach the route end. Use two slots against seven-operation carriers.
chapters.hint: A common counter can pass both opposing operations. Slot 1 acts before Slot 2.

chapters.name: Drift Field
chapters.goal: Reach the exit through the drift field.
chapters.hint: Try different equipment orders among breakable rocks and occasional enemies. Hull damage remains active.

chapters.name: Front and Back
chapters.goal: Read the carrier volleys and reach the route end.
chapters.hint: FAN repeats. SWEEP turns across three beats. GAP moves an opening. The warning fixes the attack. Carriers return through the Klein joins.

chapters.name: Last Approach
chapters.goal: Reach the final battle through the last asteroid belt.
chapters.hint: Use the quieter route to prepare your equipment. Asteroids and occasional carriers still cause hull damage.

chapters.name: The Klein Fleet
chapters.intro: The Klein Drive has been engaged. Now entering the Alice Universe
chapters.goal: Destroy the fleet. Collect the drive part, then cross the exit.
chapters.hint: FAN, SWEEP, GAP. Read the warning and the return. Ships and shots use the Klein joins. Hold Space to fire forward. Right Shift unfolds space.

chapters.name: Return Flight
chapters.goal: Learn to inhabit the Klein surface. Compare familiar attacks before and after the surface begins to matter.
chapters.hint: The Klein Relay is active. Left and Right steer through the side joins. The route keeps scrolling.

lessonNotices.text: Klein Relay active. First, read the same familiar FAN you already know.
The ship, enemies, bullets, and pickups now share the Klein surface.
Break: use the quiet space to cross a side seam deliberately.
Compare the next familiar pattern with its position on the joined surface.
Break: return to a comfortable lane before the next pattern.
Final check: use the surface without abandoning ordinary shmup reading.

chapters.name: Intentional Crossing
chapters.goal: Use the side joins as a movement tool, not just an escape accident.
chapters.hint: A seam can be the shortest safe route. Read the formation, then choose the surface path.

lessonNotices.text: Intentional Crossing: the seam is now part of your movement vocabulary.
A WALL is coming. The local gap is tight; the side seam gives you another route.
Break: cross once on purpose, then watch where the screen representation returns you.
Do not chase the empty screen. Choose the safest path on the whole surface.
Break: light formation only. Reset your position.
Use the seam before the WALL closes your local lane.
Final crossing: combine ordinary dodging with a deliberate surface shortcut.

chapters.name: Returning Fire
chapters.goal: Track familiar attacks after they cross the Klein joins.
chapters.hint: The grammar is unchanged. What changes is where the same shot returns.

lessonNotices.text: Returning Fire: first read the ordinary pattern.
RETURN uses the same grammar but sends outer trajectories through the side join.
Break: old bullets may still return. Read the surface before moving into empty space.
GAP + RETURN: the visible opening is only part of the answer.
Break: no new rule. Let the previous return clear.
SWEEP + RETURN: track the committed pattern beyond the visible edge.
Final check: predict the return before the projectile leaves the screen.

chapters.name: Seam Gap
chapters.goal: Find the safe opening on the whole Klein surface.
chapters.hint: A local gap can close when an older volley returns. Read the surface, not only the screen.

chapters.name: Cross Current
chapters.goal: Read two familiar pattern families at once.
chapters.hint: Pattern layering begins here. FAN, SWEEP, GAP and RETURN remain the same grammar.

chapters.name: Fold Timing
chapters.goal: Use folds to change when an already-understood pattern arrives.
chapters.hint: Geometry tells you where. Fold depth changes when. Density drops while timing complexity rises.

chapters.name: Pressure Field
chapters.goal: Survive the established grammar at true bullet-hell density.
chapters.hint: No new topology rule. Density, overlap and enemy count rise while the geometry stays familiar.

chapters.name: Klein Mastery
chapters.goal: Combine seam travel, returning fire, folds and layered bullet fields.
chapters.hint: Nothing here is new. Use the entire Klein vocabulary, then reach the quiet approach.

chapters.name: The Projective Intrusion
chapters.intro: Projective identification detected. Klein and projective rules are overlapping.
chapters.goal: Survive the hybrid geometry. Destroy the intrusion, recover the Projective Module, and extract.
chapters.hint: The attack grammar is unchanged. Watch which boundary rule each return uses.

chapters.name: Projective Chart
chapters.goal: Learn the Projective Module’s antipodal boundary and keep the forward gun.
chapters.hint: Left and Right steer. Side and longitudinal joins have different return directions.

chapters.name: Echo Capture
chapters.goal: Press C near a hostile projectile to turn danger into a stored echo.
chapters.hint: Capture is deliberate, limited by range and cooldown; do not treat it as invulnerability.

chapters.name: Echo Release
chapters.goal: Press E to spend stored echoes as forward shots while continuing to fire with Space.
chapters.hint: Capture, choose your firing lane, then release. Power comes from the field you survived.

chapters.name: Ordered Synthesis
chapters.goal: Combine echo release with the seven established ordered operations.
chapters.hint: Slot order remains consequential. The Projective Module gives an extra interaction, not a replacement gun.

chapters.name: Stellar Harvest
chapters.goal: Harvest projectiles from dense but readable enemy populations.
chapters.hint: More enemies supply more danger and more possible power. Capture requires positioning.

chapters.name: Antipodal Storm
chapters.goal: Read returning patterns, grow a build, and keep the player collision core visible.
chapters.hint: The attack grammar is unchanged; now its projective return can be converted into strength.

chapters.name: Power Without Passivity
chapters.goal: Manage a growing build without losing meaningful manual control.
chapters.hint: Orbitals spend stored echoes. Ward uses two echoes. Capture and release still require judgment.

chapters.name: Projective Mastery
chapters.goal: Complete the full learn → capture → build → release loop.
chapters.hint: Nothing new: shoot, dodge, use identifications, transform threats, build power, and choose when to spend it.

chapters.name: The Curvature Gate
chapters.intro: A hyperbolic anomaly detected beyond the projective chart.
chapters.goal: Defeat the gate, collect its Curvature Seed, and extract.
chapters.hint: Your projective echo abilities remain active. The curvature cues are a gameplay prototype, not a completed hyperbolic double-torus metric.

tutorial.name: First contact
tutorial.goal: Clear the first contact to enter the route.
tutorial.hint: Left / Right steer. Hold Space to fire. Left Shift folds; Right Shift unfolds. Both sides’ shots accelerate in folded space.

operations.name: Position Warp
effects: Move a shot to the opposite side.
Open one side while retaining danger on the other.

operations.name: Vector Lens
effects: Set outward lateral velocity; reduce forward velocity.
Change a crossing route without removing the shot.

operations.name: Path Bend
effects: Trade a clear center for danger farther out.

operations.name: Impact Buffer
effects: Apply a hit after a 0.8-second delay.
Buy time; a stored hit can still defeat its target.

operations.name: Arrival Delay
effects: Keep contact damage, including during the hold.

operations.name: Distance Anchor
effects: Create room while retaining the threat.

operations.name: Utility Exchange
effects: Advance the next shot by 0.12 seconds at the cost of a heavier threat.

ships.name: Arrow
ships.weakness: Needs more room than Needle in narrow gaps.

ships.name: Skater
ships.strength: Crosses wide patterns faster; brakes sharply.
ships.weakness: Has a brief ramp when starting or reversing.

ships.name: Needle
ships.strength: Its smaller core fits narrower bullet gaps.
ships.weakness: Takes longer to cross a wide pattern.

ships.name: Aftwing
ships.strength: Reverse drive is 50% faster in Act IV. Its core is smaller than Arrow.
ships.weakness: Crosses the screen more slowly than the starter ships.
ships.handles: Trades lateral speed for Act IV reverse drive

evolutions.name: Split Echo
evolutions.description: Released echoes split into three narrower shots.

evolutions.name: Projective Twin
evolutions.description: Each release adds one mirrored companion shot.

evolutions.name: Echo Orbit
evolutions.description: Automatically spend one stored echo on a periodic forward satellite.

evolutions.name: Echo Ward
evolutions.description: Spend two stored echoes to stop one otherwise-damaging hostile shot.

fan.name: FAN
fan.purpose: Several angles radiate from one source.

sweep.name: SWEEP
sweep.purpose: The firing direction changes over committed beats.

gap.name: GAP
gap.purpose: A dense field leaves a readable opening.

aimed.name: AIMED
aimed.purpose: A shot commits to the player position during the warning.

burst.name: BURST
burst.purpose: Several rapid volleys separated by recovery.

wall.name: WALL
wall.purpose: A broad obstruction pressures route choice.

spiral.name: SPIRAL
spiral.purpose: A rotating emission develops over time.

return.name: RETURN
return.purpose: A familiar attack deliberately exploits a surface join.
